statement: Closest existing work: the proposed semantic+temporal relevance mechanism is already published twice over (a fixed BM25+dense+exponential-decay hybrid evaluated on a temporal benchmark, and learnable exponential decay inside graph-based RAG). The overlap is at the level of mechanism and benchmark recipe; the residual distinctions are (i) attaching the temporal term to an arbitrary base retriever rather than building a fixed hybrid, (ii) validity/as-of semantics rather than recency, and (iii) a corpus of continuously amended statutes with near-duplicate successive versions. If (i)-(iii) are not realized as substantive findings, the delta is application- and ablation-level.

evidence.quote: We propose a three-signal hybrid framework integrating BM25 lexical matching, dense semantic embeddings, and exponential temporal decay, which achieves 99.8% temporal accuracy and 50.8% entity precision across all three languages
Layer 2 integrates learnable exponential decay functions into graph-based retrieval
